feeds.title: RNDM Canada Blog
feeds.description: The Sisters of Our Lady of the Missions (RNDM) Canada are part of an international community of Catholic Sisters who live and work in twenty countries around the world. As part of the web of life within the community of earth, we seek to learn, educate, and practice justice with ever-expanding circles of need and purpose.

feeds.title: Catholic Insight
feeds.description: Catholic Insight seeks to enlighten hearts and minds by proclaiming the splendour of truth and the sanctity of life. It endeavours to foster the culture of life by reporting truthfully, critically, contextually, and comparatively with a view to history and guided by a cultural vision inspired by Catholic doctrine and the classical liberal arts.

feeds.title: Catholic Saskatoon News
feeds.description: Catholic Saskatoon News is a Diocesan news portal. Here you will find articles, opinions, and news abut religion, faith, spirituality, and more.

feeds.title: Canadian Catholic News
feeds.description: Canadian Catholic News (CCN) is a coast-to-coast co-operative news service serving Catholic media across Canada. It brings together the efforts of Catholic newspapers, radio, and television, providing a trustworthy picture of the Catholic Church, and examining national and regional issues through the prism of Catholic social teachings.

feeds.title: Roman Catholic Diocese of Calgary Blog
feeds.description: Bishop William T. McGrattan was appointed by Pope Francis to succeed Bishop Frederick Henry as the 8th bishop of the Diocese of Calgary. Bishop McGrattan is a bishop who prioritizes pastoral relationships. And he wants one with each of us. He takes his role as a shepherd seriously, but knowing he cannot singlehandedly meet the needs of each of his 400,000 sheep, he is strengthening his relationship with his priests so they can strengthen relationships with their parishioners.

feeds.title: Seeds of Faith
feeds.description: Featuring posts by members of the Novalis publishing team, as well as leading Catholic educators and pastoral ministers, Novalis Seeds of Faith Blog provides a thoughtful and engaging commentary on faith, spirituality, and Church life. Novalis produces creative and affordable resources that help people to explore their religious heritage, live their faith, deepen their relationship with Christ, pray, take part actively in the liturgical and sacramental life of their Church, and participate in the creation of a more just world.

feeds.title: Catholic Women's Leadership Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Catholic Women's Leadership Foundation enables an influential voice for Catholic women in Canada through collaboration, education, and supportive networks. Our goal is to become the leading authority in Canadian Catholic women's leadership through the development of diverse programs and activities.

feeds.title: Catholic Canada
feeds.description: Catholic Canada is in the midst of upgrading and setting the groundwork for the future of this 25-year-old great Canadian Catholic web endeavor. In this time of darkness, Catholic Canada's approach is to carry articles by and for Canadians or by anybody else that will inform and promote the Way Truth and Life of Christ Jesus.

feeds.title: Everyday For Life Canada
feeds.description: Everyday For Life Canada is a blog discussing Christian life, religion, god, life, school boards, and more.

feeds.title: CIA Blog
feeds.description: CIA - Catholic Intell Association A Watchdog Exposing the Ottawa Catholic school board OCSB. Tips and Leads are welcome! You will be kept anonymous!!

feeds.title: Canadian Catholic
feeds.description: Canadian Catholic is an on-line destination for young, faithful, Canadian Catholics. It is for those who seek to live lives of integrity & authenticity of faith, and to offer a bold and joyful witness to the world. If you desire to grow in faith, understanding, and the ability to communicate meaningfully with people of the modern world, then you've come to the right place. Join the conversation.

feeds.title: The B.C. Catholic
feeds.description: The B.C. Catholic is the official newspaper of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Vancouver. They tell stories that reveal the heart of Jesus Christ and draw people to his Church.

feeds.title: Catholic Missions In Canada
feeds.description: Catholic Missions In Canada is an incorporated Canadian registered charity. We are constantly vigilant that the purpose of our organization is primarily the proclamation of the Gospel. While our organization has existed since 1908, Catholic Mission In Canada is not well known, nor is the existence of mission communities within our country. We strive to bring national awareness to the fact that the Catholic Church is not fully established in Canada.

feeds.title: The Catholic Register
feeds.description: Canada's Catholic news source since 1893. The Catholic Register, Canada's oldest English Catholic weekly in Canada. Our mission is to provide intelligent, comprehensive, and faith-filled journalism and to ensure that the views of Catholics and our Church are proclaimed in a way to inform and influence our media and policy makers.
